title: ci: a per-package suite-duration ratchet — a PR that makes a suite exceed its measured ceiling is red; ceilings rise only by ruling (maintainer-directed, growth constraint)
body:
Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) on the maintainer's direction, 2026-09-07T02:5xZ. Surface owner stays `domain:devx`.

**Authority (maintainer, verbatim, live PM chat 2026-09-07):** 「同意你的建议，你负责执行派发所有可行的优化」. This card is the growth constraint of the long-term plan.

## What

A per-package suite-duration ratchet: each package's measured `test` duration has a ceiling (the refreshed measurement plus headroom), a PR that makes a suite exceed it is red, and a ceiling is raised only by a ruling — the same rule the line and token ratchets already apply to the skill corpus.

## Measured

- `@objectstack/cli` measured 458 s on 2026-08-24; the shard carrying it measured 28m46s two weeks later; nothing turned red on the PRs that made it slower. Test files grow by 35–89 a day (3,388 against 2,183 source files).
- The measurement exists per run (the turbo summaries; the per-file table from #16454).

## Ruling

1. Ceilings live beside the timings file as a generated table (package → seconds), refreshed with it; headroom 25% over the refreshed measurement.
2. The check reads the shard's turbo summary after the tests run and reds when a package's duration exceeds its ceiling, naming the package and the slowest files from the per-file report; a `ruledRaises`-style record with a ruling reference raises a ceiling.
3. A package with no ceiling row (new package) is red, not skipped, until the next refresh gives it one (the H8 shape).

## Serial

Blocked behind #16454 (W): the per-file report is its input and both land in the shard job's test step. Dispatched when W merges.

Refs #16173.
